findings.text: _dispatched_head_for_row composes the dispatched head the same way scripts/review_rows_with_another_rounds_verdict.py:59 _dispatched_head does — loop the declared write_paths through _review_record_subject, then fall back to round_node_head_suffix(node, REVIEW_NODE_PREFIX) — so the capability now has two implementations and no package owner; the node could have hoisted the composition beside _review_record_subject or round_node_head_suffix and reused it from the script, but the script's copy was left in place.

the tests: line records a bare checkout-runnable command (uv run pytest ...) but no result and not the literal command the logs ran, which used PATH=/usr/bin:$PATH and the absolute .venv interpreter at the head-gate-full.log:2 header; the field's contract asks for the command that actually ran and its result, and the discrepancy is left implicit rather than stated.
